thread: Jordan: Quick note from the microbench: steal + kv-mismatch is the dominant p95 culprit for small requests. If we can cheaply detect kv_affinity mismatch at admission we could avoid costly steals. Riya: How would detection look? Jordan: Use a tiny bloom filter per-slot that tracks recent kv keys; admission checks approximate membership. Low-cost, probabilistic. Omar: Bloom false positives okay (we just avoid steal), false negatives cost us misses. Should tune for FPR ~1-2%. Riya: Also consider marking a warmness score on token meta (0-1) from recent hits. Use that as another multiplier on kv_penalty. ci-bot: build/exp-rt-bloomfilt succeeded. Jordan: I'll write up a short baseline experiment tying bloomfilt to steal decisions. Riya: Add metric: bloom_false_positive_rate and warmness_score distribution. Omar: Make sure bloom state is sharded and bounded memory. We'll need eviction policy. Jordan: Noted.
